scientific_name: Tetranychus urticae (and related spider mite species)
description: Red spider mites are tiny arachnid pests that feed on plant sap by piercing leaf cells. They reproduce quickly in warm and dry conditions and can cause serious damage to crops by reducing photosynthesis and weakening plants.
symptoms: Small pale or yellow spots on leaves (stippling)
Fine silk webbing on leaves and stems
Severely weakened plants or plant death
impact: Sunburn on fruits due to canopy loss
Plant weakening or death in severe infestations
cultural_control: Remove heavily infested leaves or plants
Avoid dusty conditions in fields or greenhouses
chemical_control: Miticides or acaricides when infestations are severe
Use selective pesticides compatible with biological control
prevention: Monitor leaves regularly with a hand lens
